items.title: Confirm whether the window-replacement appointment can be kept
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte innerhalb von 10 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum mit (Werktage sind Montag bis Samstag außer gesetzlichen Feiertagen), ob Sie den Termin wahrnehmen können.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is 16.12.2026 (Wednesday). The period runs 'ab dem Briefdatum'; per §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event itself is not counted, so counting starts on 17.12.2026 (Thursday). 'Werktage' are defined by the letter as Monday through Saturday excluding statutory holidays; Sundays and holidays are skipped, 24.12. is not a statutory holiday in NRW and counts, 25.12. and 26.12. are statutory holidays in NRW and are skipped. Counting workdays: 1) Thu 17.12, 2) Fri 18.12, 3) Sat 19.12, (Sun 20.12 skipped), 4) Mon 21.12, 5) Tue 22.12, 6) Wed 23.12, 7) Thu 24.12, (Fri 25.12 holiday skipped, Sat 26.12 holiday skipped, Sun 27.12 skipped), 8) Mon 28.12, 9) Tue 29.12, 10) Wed 30.12. The 10th Werktag, and thus the deadline for the reply to reach the cooperative, is 30.12.2026.
